purpose: Test joint branch/trunk optimization as a single-material fitting hypothesis; not operator generalization.
initialization: Both from identical seed2 seven-channel initial state, from scratch; frozen branch remains at initial weights throughout
optimizer: Adam lr0.001, only requires_grad parameters; trunk and scalar bias trained in both arms
selection: fixed final4000, no early stop or validation selection
metrics: frozen branch hashes and finite state/gradient audits
scope: Constant material encoding diagnostic at training000 only. Cannot prove trunk capacity limitation if both arms fail, and frozen branch is not a learned new-material operator.
